case_order: primary_cases in listed order, then remaining frozen fixture order
boundary: PDP: first target-dependent coefficient descent through independently verified basis, root extraction, original-equation checks and curve replay. Input fixture construction, ring-only plan construction, library loading and result serialization excluded. Algebra controls: frozen coefficient packing through independently certified materialized basis; not complete PDP queries.
cache_policy: Only loaded libraries and ring-only coefficient-descent layouts are reused. Each target gets fresh coefficients, solving and certification. Column support maps, pivot arrays and numerical rows are constructed afresh inside each timed matrix reduction.
resource_envelope: One process, one sequential query at a time, one CPU query thread. No GPU, target batching or cross-target answer cache. Native work/node/row limits, not a hard wall timeout.
primary_acceptance: All three qualified trials on all five primary cases must contain seven verified measured pairs, with the lower paired-bootstrap median-ratio 95% bound above one for baseline/indexed. No routing promotion follows a partial panel.
two_times_target: A target only: report whether every primary lower bound for baseline/indexed reaches two, separately from measured central ratios.
uncertainty: Per-case/trial descriptive paired bootstrap intervals. No familywise or population guarantee. Repeated fixtures do not constitute natural-yield observations.
comparison: Round 58 baseline (exact round 56 chain_filter) versus indexed columns with the 262144-column sparse fallback. Both are CPU implementations. This panel measures the incremental representation change; round 57 retains the separate F4/evaluation comparison.
